contexts.text: They who are in falsities from evil appear as basilisks and crocodiles.
In the Word, the deceitful are signified by... crocodiles and vipers; and deceit, by their poison.
Self-love causes its cupidities to appear there like crocodiles, etc.
They are like pirates, who, at sea, are crocodiles.
As to the teeth, they are like crocodiles.
Their friendship is like a young crocodile in a cake of honey.
The crocodile turns its food into poison...

The effort to ascend on high (of those who had been both revengeful and pious) appeared like a crocodile of an ugly colour with a long and broad tail rising on high... perpendicularly... But as the communication with the Angels was taken away, so the crocodile descended...
